core_value_prop: Log an expense and see its impact on the current budget.

notification_copy_examples: Check how this week's purchases affect your remaining budget.

lazy_thumb.compressed_core_action: Open Quick Log and enter the amount

paved_path.zero_choice_landing_behavior: Resume Quick Log from the shortcut
preselected_defaults: Use the local date and the last user-selected category

variable_reward.reward_of_hunt: Surface a useful new spending insight
variable_reward.reward_of_tribe: Let the user share a goal milestone with their budget partner
variable_reward.reward_of_self: Show which budget goal the user protected
variable_reward.variability_schedule: Show a new insight when a verified pattern changes

dead_end_replacements: Recover an empty log with Quick Log
continuous_loop_implementations: Leave Done available and let people select Add another

stored_value.reentry_value: Restore the active budget and recent categories
stored_value.data_controls: Export CSV, edit entries, and delete history

implementation_roadmap.success_metric: 7-day repeat completed logs and time to first saved expense
implementation_roadmap.hypothesis: Returning to Quick Log and shortening entry increases completed logs without raising aborts or duplicate saves.
